linkedinPostId.description: LinkedIn activity ID. Upper 41 bits encode a millisecond timestamp (INFERENCE when decoded). Key is absent in 3,364 v1 records.

Content.description: Post text as captured. May contain platform placeholder strings; see data dictionary.

AuthorPublicIdentifier.description: Public profile slug of the posting account. Personal data; see ethics statement. Null in 23,894 v1 records.

Views.description: View count at observation time. Zero usually means not captured; treat as missing.
